_comment: THE ONLY FILE TO EDIT when pointing this task at a different ASR target. No file outside this one and harness/backends/ may name a model, a runtime, or a language. The target is fixed; the submission only hooks around it.

streaming._note: only read when mode is streaming; the adapter implements transcribe_stream

target.paradigm_note: Optional target paradigm: AED | SPEECH_LLM | TRANSDUCER | NAR_CIF_CTC | HYBRID | null. An adapter may declare the same via its `paradigm` attribute; models.json wins when both are set.
target._decode_note: Frozen for BOTH arms. A submission may override only the keys listed in `tunable`; everything else is part of the instrument.
target._backend_note: backend is a key into harness/backends/. `dummy` is an instrument self-test and produces meaningless transcripts; replace it with your runtime adapter before any real run.

submission._note: max_extra_weights_bytes > 0 is the only sanctioned way to ship trained params (a distilled student, a rescoring LM). It must be declared in manifest.json and counted against the task budget.

stock_reference._comment: Fill this after your first stock measurement. benchmark.py warns when the stock arm drifts more than 2% from it -- that means the instrument moved, not the submission.
